rows.label: PPP conversion factor (2017 international $ per US $)

source.title: World Bank, via GiveWell's GiveDirectly CEA

rows.label: Under-five mortality rate (2016)

rows.label: Under-five mortality rate (2024)

source.title: UN IGME estimates, via World Bank World Development Indicators API

rows.explainer: Probability of dying before age five per live birth in Kenya, 2024, UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (IGME) as republished by the World Bank (38.8 per 1,000, stored as a share). National average; the IGME uncertainty interval is not carried here.
